summary: Strava collects extensive personal and activity data, shares some with advertisers and partners, uses data for AI features, tracks precise location, retains data until you delete it (up to 45 days), and lets you delete your information.

findings.plain: Strava tracks your exact location for core features, but you can stop sharing it in your device settings.
findings.quote: Location Information: We collect or infer location information when you sign up for and use the Services... you must grant us permission through your device to track your device’s precise location.

findings.plain: Strava keeps your data as long as needed for the service, generally until you delete it, with deletion taking up to 45 days.
